function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Hai! Untuk mengetahui kapan produk berwarna pink akan restock, biasanya kami memeriksa stok secara berkala dan mengupdate statusnya di website atau aplikasi kami. Jika Anda sudah melihat bahwa produk tersebut sedang out-of-stock, Anda bisa:

1. **Cek kembali setiap hari** – Stok seringkali diperbarui beberapa kali sehari.
2. **Daftar ke notifikasi** – Di halaman produk, aktifkan tombol “Beritahu Saya” (atau “Notify Me”) agar kami mengirim email/WhatsApp saat produk tersedia lagi.
3. **Hubungi customer service** – Kirim pesan lewat chat di situs/aplikasi atau kirim WhatsApp ke nomor layanan pelanggan kami. Kami akan memberi tahu perkiraan waktu restock.

Jika ada pertanyaan lain atau bantuan yang dibutuhkan, silakan beri tahu saya!
message.reasoning: The user says: "Warna pink kapan restok kak". This is Indonesian: "When will the pink color restock?" They want to know when the pink color product will restock. We need to respond politely. There's no function call needed. Just answer.
